score_reasons.quality: Studio-grade 3D product rendering: believable matte plastics on the visor and straps, convincing PCB detail with a legible XR2 chip, glossy pancake lens elements with realistic reflections, and a soft glowing accent line. Clean edges, no geometry defects; only a faint duplicated ghost line of watermark text near the lower-left callout counts as a rendering artifact.
score_reasons.aesthetics: Professional exploded-diagram poster: vertical stack centered on a soft purple-blue gradient, 3+5 callout columns create clear information hierarchy, consistent blue leader lines and typography; lighting is even studio style with gentle grounding shadows. Very cohesive and polished.
score_reasons.alignment: Header logo ∞ + Meta Quest 3: correct. Eight callouts in the required 3-left/5-right arrangement: present, and most copy is verbatim correct. Layer stack is close to the requested 9 (top strap, camera wings with three tracking cameras, motherboard, pancake lens unit, main visor shell, battery, side strap, facial cushion) though the 'internal frame' layer is not distinctly separable and only one side strap is clearly shown. Leader-line targeting is partially imprecise (e.g., フェイスプレート/バッテリー arrows land near the strap rather than their parts). Header subtitle and two callout titles are misspelled, see transcription.
score_reasons.real_world_fidelity: Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2 is the correct real chip for this product and the PCB/battery/lens internals are plausible; however the rendered visor front (curved glossy shell with glowing rim) resembles a generic/PSVR2-like headset more than the actual angular Quest 3 front plate, so real-product fidelity is only approximate. Trademark text use stays within product-ad conventions.
score_reasons.creative_generation: Excellent execution of a complex infographic brief: seamless fusion of photoreal 3D parts with poster typography, strong reading order (title → layers → footer copy), and effective use of glow accents and gradient for a high-tech mood.
